backend/main.mo: Actor with user profile and product management using access control, storing profiles, products, and metadata in maps.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence entries mapping features to affected files, components, tests, and confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries describing responsibilities of numerous frontend source files.
frontend/index.css: Defines global Tailwind CSS variables for light/dark themes with accent, surface, and border tokens.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML shell loading JSZip and jsPDF via CDN and mounting the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app managing authentication, profile setup, onboarding, navigation, and product workflow views.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button using Internet Identity with dynamic aria labels and error handling.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog for entering and saving the user's name during initial profile setup.
frontend/src/components/errors/GlobalErr: React error boundary showing a user-friendly error page with reload option and dev-only error details.
frontend/src/components/export/ExportIns: Renders a tabbed instructional guide explaining how to use the app, customize products, generate files, and prepare them for sale. Uses UI components and icons to structure steps and tips.
frontend/src/components/export/ExportScr: Provides a UI for downloading generated product PDFs and ZIPs individually or as a combined master ZIP. Handles download logic, error states, and file size formatting.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the main app layout with header navigation, authentication-aware controls, and buttons for exporting, previewing, and viewing instructions. Wraps and displays child content.
frontend/src/components/onboarding/Onboa: Displays a modal containing the full export instructions for onboarding users. Includes a close button and scrollable content.
frontend/src/components/preview/PdfPrevi: Shows an iframe preview of a generated PDF or an alert if none exists. Manages object URL creation and cleanup for the PDF blob.
frontend/src/components/preview/UnifiedP: Displays all products with their covers, descriptions, and PDF previews in a unified grid. Supports expanding descriptions and navigating back.
frontend/src/components/preview/ZipConte: Lists the files and folders that will appear in a product's ZIP export, dynamically including templates, checklists, and prompts. Renders the list in a scrollable card.
frontend/src/components/products/Product: Product editor UI allowing editing of fields, modules, prompts, templates, and checklists with handlers for add, update, and remove actions.
Workspace managing multiple product entries, autosaving drafts, and triggering single or bulk product bundle generation with error handling.
frontend/src/components/storefront/Store: Displays a product card with cover, truncated description, expand toggle, and an edit button.
Renders a storefront grid of default products with a header and navigation back to the editor.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides authentication context using Internet Identity, handling login, identity loading, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useOnboardingInstruct: Manages onboarding-instructions modal state, persistence, and auto‑open behavior via localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching and saving the caller's user profile using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base/theme configuration defining light/dark color tokens and accessibility-focused global styles.
frontend/src/lib/assets/covers.ts: Maps product IDs to cover image paths and provides helpers to fetch cover images as blobs.
frontend/src/lib/defaultProducts.ts: Defines default product entries with metadata, modules, prompts, templates, and checklists.
frontend/src/lib/downloads.ts: Provides utilities to download blobs or files by creating temporary links.
frontend/src/lib/filename.ts: Generates slugified, date-tagged filenames for PDFs, ZIPs, and bundles.
frontend/src/lib/generation/generateAllB: Iterates through products to generate bundles with optional progress reporting.
frontend/src/lib/generation/generateProd: Generates a product’s PDF and ZIP bundle, including cover fetching and error handling.
frontend/src/lib/localDrafts.ts: Loads, saves, and resets localStorage-backed product draft data with versioning.
Creates a multi-page PDF for a product using jsPDF, adding cover, description, modules, and prompts.
frontend/src/lib/zip/buildAllProductsZip: Builds a master ZIP containing all product ZIPs plus a consolidated README.
frontend/src/lib/zip/buildProductZip.ts: Builds a ZIP for a single product including PDF, cover, templates, checklists, prompts, and README.
frontend/src/lib/zip/readmeContent.ts: Generates reusable README sections for app usage and marketplace upload instructions.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with query client and identity provider.
frontend/src/types/productEntry.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for product entries, modules, and generated bundles.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Helpers to read URL parameters, persist them in sessionStorage, and manage hash-based parameter cleanup.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending colors, radius, shadows, animations, and enabling typography, container queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking app goals, architecture notes, known issues, and feature definitions for generating digital product files.
